verdict.rationale: Databricks has a first-party docs page under its partner section that explains what dbt is, how to install dbt Core, and how to connect it to Databricks. That is vendor documentation for running dbt against the platform. The evidence names neither the adapter nor any in-platform dbt project execution, and offers no hands-on corroboration, so this is a modest full. Missing for 10: explicit naming and documentation of the dbt adapter, native in-platform dbt project/job support, dbt Cloud integration detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
